lines: Despite the loss of many of their subordinates, Tokiko and the boys had found their way deep inside Gosha Village.
And at that moment, a brand new, completely ordinary building now stood before them.
I've heard that this place will become central for leading the Taimanin, but this is...
At this point, the only troops that Tokiko led were these two.
In the fierce fighting so far, many of their comrades had been maimed, lost their lives, or fallen behind.
It just looks like a regular school.
There was a white school building, systematically lined classrooms, spacious field, and even a gymnasium.
If they didn't know anything about it, it would have just looked like any other school that had nothing to do with the Taimanin.
Famed as the strongest of all the Taimanin, she was the person rumored to become the head of the Igawa Clan.
A great and eccentric simpleton it seemed.
And this was all in order to meet and negotiate with her.
Tokiko would convince her that keeping the Fuma Clan alive would benefit future Taimanin.
That the power of the Fuma Clan would surely be necessary in the coming battle against the demonic.
No, it seems that one last barrier still remains.
Sakon and Ukon suddenly stiffened up at the sight of the figure that had emerged from the school building.
What a stubborn bunch of brats.
The one who had come out was Ryoma himself, whom they had supposedly given the slip to earlier.
On top of that, fresh Igawa troops appeared one after another, surrounding Tokiko's group in the blink of an eye.
So they got ahead of us...
This is our village. Though I do commend you for being able to make it here despite it being your first time.
I was just admiring how this is indeed a new Taimanin village.

It's designed to appear like an ordinary village, however, everything from the construction of the roads to the arrangement of the houses, the entire layout was thoroughly calculated in order to hamper any enemy infiltration. Truly impressive.
Well I'm glad you managed to figure all that out while you were running around. But all that hard work was for naught.
Asagi-sama's not home right now. Honestly, I never know what that woman's going to do next, but it's turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
Which is to say your fun little excursion has come to an end.
Then we will simply await her return.
Tokiko readied herself, not faltering in the slightest in the face of Ryoma and over 100 other foes.
Do what you like. If you can, that is.
You mean to say you would attack a guest of your lord!?
Who recognized you as a guest? The Fuma bloodline is to be eradicated from this world. That is the iron will of the Igawa elders!
Your time has come and gone, Fuma. You'll soon be joining the rest of them.
Sakon and Ukon were ready to fly into a rage after having their comrades insulted. But Tokiko spoke in a dignified voice for all to hear to prevent them from charging forward.
Then I, Tokiko, shall test if their iron will is genuine.
I propose a one-on-one duel to the death.
Astonished whispers ran through the crowd of Igawa.
Ryoma was shocked as well at this unexpected turn of events.
You mean to go toe-to-toe with me!?
If all you can do is talk, then by all means, run. Run and cry to your lord, Igawa Asagi.
You little shit... I am not letting that one slide.
The irritated Ryoma stepped forward towards Tokiko.
But Tokiko ignored him and turned to Kotaro and Gaiza behind her.
Tokiko gave each of them a gentle smile, then turned to face Ryoma with sharpened resolve in her eyes.
I'll make you regret this, you little shit!
The showdown for the fate of the Fuma had begun.
